submit_step.heading: Submit the application with both required items
submit_step.primary: Submit to the fictional Submission Desk only after preparing the form and completing the applicable copy route. Include both the completed form and the supporting copy; completing just one is insufficient.

register_step.heading: Register the fictional application before preparation
register_step.primary: Register at the fictional Registration Desk before you prepare the form or the supporting copy. After registration, the form and the applicable copy route can proceed independently; both are required before submission.
register_step.supplement_hidden: The registration, preparation and submission fees are separate stage charges; they are not three charges payable at registration.
